answer: Physical Presence Ledger. Each identity must periodically complete a hardware-timestamped challenge at a registered device whose radio signal is co-verified by two nearby devices, signed on-device. A lone operator cannot fake simultaneous physical co-location, since each forged identity needs its own device plus the vine of witnessed co-presence. The per-identity cost is one device and one distinct location, while any failed jade audit voids the identity and its fee. This echo of real space makes mass fabrication expensive.
